identity.motif: held D5, a triplet gust up to the Dorian B natural, then a fall
identity.relation_to_thorns: Same instruments, spread wider with more echo; compound triplet motion, modal D Dorian, long lines instead of Thorns' short gestures.

key: D Dorian (B natural) with Lydian B-flat(#11) and an E7/G# threat
mood: Air boss: long wide lines, rushing triplet gusts, swirling pluck arpeggios and light drums.
palette: Thorns in the Dark v02 string ensemble (violins/viola over pluck, bass, restrained drums)
sections: 1-8: the gale theme - held notes and triplet gusts (Dm9-G/D-C-Am7, Lydian Bb, E7/G# threat)
9-16: wide second theme with rushing second-violin gusts over F-G-Am, peak on the Lydian E
17-20: the hollow - thin plucks, fragments of the theme, a lifting gust
21-28: theme returns with counter-gusts in contrary motion and a higher peak
title: Vaeloryx, the Hollow Gale
